Hell had cowboys long before Pantera put them on wax. But Dimebag gave them a soundtrack — six strings of barbed wire and a grin that said 'come closer.'
Now the cowboy is bone. The hat stays on. The riffs echo through dust and distortion forever. This hoodie is the skeleton's second ride — southern, unholy, eternal.

etsy_description: Ride with the undead cowboys of metal in this Pantera cowboy skeleton hoodie. Inspired by Cowboys from Hell — the 1990 album that detonated groove metal into existence — this gothic pullover features striking skeleton cowboy artwork that channels the southern grit and outlaw spirit of the greatest heavy band Texas ever produced. It's a tribute to Dimebag Darrell, the man whose riffs rewired every guitarist's brain and whose legacy rides eternal through the metal underground. The dark art skull design is bold, detailed, and unapologetically heavy, printed on premium fabric that holds up to real-world abuse. This hoodie doesn't sit in your closet — it lives on your back at shows, on rides, and through every cold night that needs a little hellfire. Unisex sizing fits everyone from the front row to the back of the venue. A perfect heavy metal gift for the Pantera faithful, the Dimebag devoted, and anyone who believes that cowboys and metal were always meant to collide. From the Deathlipse underground — for the select few still riding out of Hell.
